data.summary: Elektro Beispielfunke GmbH billed Anton Musterschmidt €1,792.14 for supplying and installing an 11 kW wallbox and related electrical work at his garage on 13 October 2026. The invoice, dated 16 October 2026, is payable within 8 days of that date.
data.explanation: This is an invoice from your electrician for installing an EV charging station at your home. Pay the full amount shown to the company's bank account by the deadline the app calculates (counted from the invoice date). If you miss it, the company can send a reminder or charge late-payment interest. Keep the invoice for at least two years, as German law requires. Part of the labour cost may also be deductible on your tax return as a craftsman service (Handwerkerleistung, § 35a EStG); a tax advisor can confirm the deductible share.
